title: What is the most common problem with Samsung washing machines (top load)?
desc: Typically, the Samsung washing machine issue is a dirty drain filter or screen, which leads to excess water in the load. This can cause excessive forces during the spin cycle, potentially requiring the replacement of balance or damping components.

title: Why has my Samsung washing machine stopped working?
desc: First, check the power by plugging the cord into a working outlet. Also, inspect the fuse and the circuit breaker on your electrical panel. Next, close and reopen the door, then press the start/pause button. Keep in mind that there may be a brief pause before your washer starts its cycle.

title: What could be a reason for a Samsung fridge not cooling?
desc: Most cooling issues can be resolved by adjusting Samsung refrigerator settings, ensuring proper use and care, inspecting and cleaning the door seals, or resetting the Samsung appliance.

title: What is the most common Samsung fridge failure?
desc: Common refrigerator problems include insufficient cooling, blocked vents, dirty condenser coils, faulty condenser fan motors, evaporator fan issues, control panel problems, power supply issues, and poor appliance location.

title: What is the most common failure on a Samsung dishwasher?
desc: Common Samsung dishwasher problems include the dishwasher not cleaning, not draining, buttons or controls not working, lights flashing or blinking, and leaking from the motor area or other parts.

title: What are Samsung Washing Machine Error Codes?
desc:
Common Samsung washing machine error codes include:
- 4C/4E: Water supply issue
- 5C/5E: Drainage problem / PCB
- 3C/3E: Motor defect or overload
- DC/DE: Door lock error
- HE1/HE: Heating element fault
- LE/LE1: Water leakage detected
- OE/OF: Overflow error
- UB: Unbalanced load
- Sud: Too many suds detected
- tE1/tE2: Temperature sensor error
- UC: Voltage error
- bE: Button error
- AE/AE6: Communication error
- 1E: Water level sensor error
- CE: Cooling fan error

title: What are Samsung Refrigerator / Fridge Error Codes?
desc:
Common Samsung refrigerator error codes include:
- 5E: Fridge Defrost Sensor Error
- 8E: Ice Maker (Freezer) Sensor Error
- 14E: Ice Maker Sensor Error
- 33E: Ice Pipe Heater Error
- 39E / 39C: Ice Maker Function Error
- 40E / 40C: Ice Room Fan Error
- 84C: Compressor Lock

title: What are Samsung Dishwasher Error Codes?
desc:
Common Samsung dishwasher error codes include:
- 3C: Pump operation error
- 1E / IE: Clogged filter error
- 3E: High temperature water supply error
- 4C / 4E: Water supply error
- 5C / 5E: Drain error
- 7E: Water reflector error
- 9E: Low water level error
- AP: Access Point Mode

title: What are Samsung Oven Error Codes?
desc:
Common Samsung oven error codes include:
- C-20: Temperature sensor issue
- C-F0: Internal communication problem
- C-21: Temperature too high
- C-F2 / D-d0: Touch button defect
